# ABC (Australian Broadcasting Corporation)

> > Australia's national public broadcaster providing news, television, radio, and digital content across the nation and internationally.

The ABC is Australia's most trusted source of independent news and information, operating television channels (ABC TV, ABC NEWS, ABC iview), radio networks (ABC Radio National, triple j, ABC Local Radio), and digital platforms. The organization also runs ABC International Development (ABCID) programs like Future Voices in Southeast Asia.
